why: The external number is a coding benchmark at temperature 1.0, not chat prose; coding answers keep DSpark acceptance high.
It runs on four Sparks. Inkling-2-Small has 17B active parameters, so about 4.25B active work per node on average, versus 5.4B effective active work per token for Inkling-2-Mini on one Spark.
The external recipe's expert-width split adds ~24% single-stream decode on their setup; the current vLLM recipe does not have that hook.

Current Mini on comparable coding questions is 46.6-55.1 tok/s (mean 49.5), close to the external 55-56. The current recipe's low 32-37 tok/s number is chat prose, where DSpark acceptance falls to 1.1-1.4 tokens/step.
